content: {"like":["Comedy series with witty, original humor and realistic characters (e.g., Detectorists, Father Ted).","British sitcoms that feel like feature films with strong storytelling (e.g., Poirot).","Shows that balance light, uplifting narratives with everyday, relatable situations.","Series where character development and setting enhance the overall quality (e.g., Detectorists).","Movies that deliver original, engaging plots and high production values (e.g., Passengers)."],"dislike":["Shows with poor audio or visual quality, especially in older or low‑budget productions.","Comedies that rely on canned laughter or forced laugh cues.","Series where beloved characters are abruptly killed off or storylines are abruptly ended.","Episodes that feel too short or lack depth compared to longer formats.","Films that are perceived as inferior to similar genre peers (e.g., Shaun the Sheep vs. Wallace & Gromit)."]}
